Robot Open API
Update Log
V1.0.18

New features(2026-10-10)

Added Webhook subscription management endpoints: Create webhook subscription, List webhook subscriptions, Update webhook subscription, Delete webhook subscription, Verify webhook subscription and Rotate webhook subscription secret
Webhook subscriptions are scoped to the company bound to the API Key; the company cannot be passed in the request
Added List supported webhook event types so callers can load subscription event options dynamically
V1.0.17

New features(2026-08-14)

Create new temporary mission, Create new schedule and Update schedule add parameters edgeMode and windMode
Get all schedule by device returns edgeMode and windMode
windMode is supported by all series: L series(scrubber) it means Absorption strength, S/SP series(vacuum) it means Suction Power
Clarified the match rule between subSweepMode and windMode
V1.0.16
Supplemented descriptions for specific fields.(2026-04-16)
V1.0.15

New features(2026-04-08)

Added Get robot info API endpoint
Added Get robot's maintenance detail API endpoint
Added query parameter isShowNavigationMission and response fields missionInitiator and missionCanceller to the Query history missions by page API endpoint
V1.0.14

New features(2026-03-17)

Get device status returns remark
V1.0.13

New features(2026-03-02)

Query history missions by page returns taskEndReasonEnum
V1.0.12

New features(2026-02-10)

Add a new map interface: Get screenshot of map with four coordinate points
V1.0.11

New features(2025-11-13)

Query history missions by page returnsstartBattery, endBattery, taskSourceTypeEnum, meanVel and cumulativeDistance info
V1.0.10

New features(2025-10-16)

Add a new device interface: List device system errors

V1.0.9

New features(2025-08-28)

New Interfaces of favorite:

Create new favorite mission
Update favorite mission
Delete favorite msision
Run favorite mission
List favorite missions

New Interfaces of robot

Get robot setting
Update robot setting
V1.0.8

New features(2025-05-06)

Add more details in device status
Current area ids of running task
Current lap of running task
New type when create task:
Strict navigation task which can constraint angle
V1.0.7

Add audio and map open api(2024-12-20)

New interfaces of Audio:
Get volumn from device
Set device volumn
Play audio on device
Stop play audio
New interfaces of Map:
List all maps of device
Get screenshot of map
V1.0.6
Add example code for python and java(2024-11-21)
V1.0.5

Add some task end back point interfaces (2024-08-26)

New interfaces:

Create back point
Update back point
List back points
Delete back point

Create new temporary mission and Create new schedule add new parameter backPointId to specify where the robot will go when the task is finished

V1.0.4
Query history missions by page return 'taskSummaryPictureUrl' as the picture url of task summary
V1.0.3
Query history missions by page return 'errDesc' when the task is abnormal end
V1.0.2
Create new temporary/navigate mission return mission id if created successfully
Query history missions by page return mission start timestamp and end timestamp
Get device status return current mission id when device is running

Description:Device Open API

HOST: http://{Host}/app

Version: v1.0.8

[TOC]

Example Code

Notice:

The HOST varies in different regions

APAC use https://app-server-apac.cz-robots.com
EU use https://app-server-eu.cz-robots.com
US use https://app-server-us.cz-robots.com
Other use https://app-server.cz-robots.com

Get the robot's openId

View https://operation.cz-robots.com/robots and click the 'Detail' button

Java
package com.czrobots.example;


import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSON;

import javax.crypto.Mac;
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec;
import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.DataOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URL;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class OpenApiExample {

    enum Method {
        GET, POST, HEAD, OPTIONS, PUT, DELETE, TRACE, CONNECT, PATCH
    }

    private static final String HOST = "https://app-server.cz-robots.com";
    private static final String ROBOT_OPEN_ID = "ZXxxxxxx67";
    private static final String ACCESS_KEY = "6xxx7d";
    private static final String SECRET_KEY = "2xxxbd";


    private static final String HEADER_ACCESS_KEY = "X-Api-Key";
    private static final String HEADER_TIMESTAMP = "X-Api-timestamp";
    private static final String HEADER_SIGNATURE = "X-Api-signature";


    private static final char[] alphabets = "0123456789abcdef".toCharArray();

    public static String bytesToHex(byte[] data) {
        final int len = data.length;
        final char[] out = new char[len << 1];
        for (int i = 0, j = 0; i < len; i++) {
            out[j++] = alphabets[(0xF0 & data[i]) >>> 4];
            out[j++] = alphabets[0x0F & data[i]];
        }
        return new String(out);
    }

    public static void getExample() throws Exception {
        String url = "/app/openapi/v1/device/status/" + ROBOT_OPEN_ID;
        String timestamp = Instant.now().toEpochMilli() + "";

        Mac mac = Mac.getInstance("HmacSHA256");
        SecretKeySpec keySpec = new SecretKeySpec(SECRET_KEY.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8), "HmacSHA256");
        mac.init(keySpec);
        String signature = bytesToHex(mac.doFinal((Method.GET.name() + timestamp + url).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));

        HttpURLConnection connection = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(HOST + url).openConnection();
        connection.setRequestMethod(Method.GET.name());
        connection.setRequestProperty(HEADER_ACCESS_KEY, ACCESS_KEY);
        connection.setRequestProperty(HEADER_TIMESTAMP, timestamp);
        connection.setRequestProperty(HEADER_SIGNATURE, signature);
        connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json");

        int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();
        System.out.println("Response Code: " + responseCode);


        BufferedReader in = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(connection.getInputStream()));
        String inputLine;
        StringBuffer content = new StringBuffer();
        while ((inputLine = in.readLine()) != null) {
            content.append(inputLine);
        }
        in.close();
        connection.disconnect();
        System.out.println(content);
    }

    public static void postExample() throws Exception {
        String url = "/app/openapi/v1/mission/list";

        Map<String, Object> dataMap = new HashMap<>();
        dataMap.put("deviceOpenId", ROBOT_OPEN_ID);
        dataMap.put("startTimestamp", "1712725202000");
        dataMap.put("endTimestamp", "1712818791467");


        Map<String, Object> paramMap = new HashMap<>();
        paramMap.put("pageIndex", 1);
        paramMap.put("pageLength", 1);
        paramMap.put("requestData", dataMap);
        String timestamp = Instant.now().toEpochMilli() + "";

        Mac mac = Mac.getInstance("HmacSHA256");
        SecretKeySpec keySpec = new SecretKeySpec(SECRET_KEY.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8), "HmacSHA256");
        mac.init(keySpec);
        String signature = bytesToHex(mac.doFinal((Method.POST.name() + timestamp + url).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));

        HttpURLConnection connection = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(HOST + url).openConnection();
        connection.setRequestMethod(Method.POST.name());
        connection.setRequestProperty(HEADER_ACCESS_KEY, ACCESS_KEY);
        connection.setRequestProperty(HEADER_TIMESTAMP, timestamp);
        connection.setRequestProperty(HEADER_SIGNATURE, signature);
        connection.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json");
        connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json");
        connection.setDoOutput(true);
        try (DataOutputStream wr = new DataOutputStream(connection.getOutputStream())) {
            wr.writeBytes(JSON.toJSONString(paramMap));
            wr.flush();
        }

        int responseCode = connection.getResponseCode();
        System.out.println("Response Code: " + responseCode);

        BufferedReader in = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(connection.getInputStream()));
        String inputLine;
        StringBuilder response = new StringBuilder();

        while ((inputLine = in.readLine()) != null) {
            response.append(inputLine);
        }
        in.close();

        System.out.println("Response: " + response);
    }


    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        getExample();
        postExample();
    }
}
Python
import requests
import time
import hmac
import hashlib
import json

HOST = "https://app-server.cz-robots.com"

# Replace these with your actual values.
ROBOT_OPEN_ID = ""
ACCESS_KEY = ""
SECRET_KEY = ""

HEADER_ACCESS_KEY = "X-Api-Key"
HEADER_TIMESTAMP = "X-Api-timestamp"
HEADER_SIGNATURE = "X-Api-signature"


def bytes_to_hex(data):
    return ''.join(f'{byte:02x}' for byte in data)


def get_example():
    url = f"/app/openapi/v1/device/status/{ROBOT_OPEN_ID}"
    timestamp = str(int(time.time() * 1000))

    signature_string = f"GET{timestamp}{url}".encode('utf-8')
    signature = hmac.new(SECRET_KEY.encode('utf-8'), signature_string, hashlib.sha256).digest()
    signature_hex = bytes_to_hex(signature)

    headers = {
        HEADER_ACCESS_KEY: ACCESS_KEY,
        HEADER_TIMESTAMP: timestamp,
        HEADER_SIGNATURE: signature_hex
    }

    response = requests.get(HOST + url, headers=headers)
    print("Response Code:", response.status_code)
    print(response.text)


def post_example():
    url = "/app/openapi/v1/mission/list"

    param_map = {
        "pageIndex": 1,
        "pageLength": 1,
        "requestData": {
            "deviceOpenId": ROBOT_OPEN_ID,
            "startTimestamp": "1712725202000",
            "endTimestamp": "1712818791467",
        },
    }

    timestamp = str(int(time.time() * 1000))

    signature_string = f"POST{timestamp}{url}".encode('utf-8')
    signature = hmac.new(SECRET_KEY.encode('utf-8'), signature_string, hashlib.sha256).digest()
    signature_hex = bytes_to_hex(signature)

    headers = {
        HEADER_ACCESS_KEY: ACCESS_KEY,
        HEADER_TIMESTAMP: timestamp,
        HEADER_SIGNATURE: signature_hex,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "Accept": "application/json"
    }

    response = requests.post(HOST + url, headers=headers, data=json.dumps(param_map))
    print("Response Code:", response.status_code)
    print("Response:", response.text)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    get_example()
    post_example()

Schedule
Create new schedule

url:/app/openapi/v1/schedule

method:POST

produces:application/x-www-form-urlencoded,application/json

consumes:*/*

Note:

If cleanEveryWhere is false, areaIds is required. Scrubbers(L series) can only create SWEEP missions. Vacuums(S series) can create both PATROL and SWEEP missions.
If sweepMode is PATROL, subSweepMode can be one of: SPOT_CLEAN, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH.
If sweepMode is SWEEP, subSweepMode can be one of: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH. Scrubbers can also set subSweepMode to VERY_QUIET.

Example:

{
  "duration": 60,
  "mapId": 1100011697639116,
  "mapVersion": "map.1111699509667377.20230616-2.20240115-10",
  "cleanEveryWhere": false,
  "sweepMode": "PATROL",
  "subSweepMode": "HIGH",
  "edgeMode": "ON",
  "windMode": "LOW",
  "areaIds": [
    "0",
    "3"
  ],
  "fixedLaps": 1,
  "backPointId": "-1",
  "deviceOpenId": "1234",
  "startTime": "04:42 PM",
  "repeat": [
    "Mon.",
    "Tue.",
    "Wed."
    "Thur.",
    "Fri.",
    "Sat.",
  	"Sun.",
  ]
}

Params:

name	description	in	require	type
X-Api-Key	Key	header	true	string
X-Api-timestamp	timestamp	header	true	string
X-Api-signature	signature	header	true	string
createScheduleOpenRequest	CreateScheduleOpenRequest	body	true	
  deviceOpenId	your device open id		true	string
  duration	task time limit, unit(minutes), [1, 1440]. Will be ignored if HOMING		false	integer
  mapId	map id that task will use		true	integer
  mapVersion	map id version that task will use		true	string
  cleanEveryWhere	option to enable/disable cleaning of the entire place. if false,areaIds should not empty. Will be ignored if HOMING		false	boolean
  sweepMode	clean mode,values:PATROL,HOMING,SWEEP		true	string
  subSweepMode	sweep intensity,values:VERY_QUIET, LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH,SPOT_CLEAN
default value: LOW		false	string
  edgeMode	edge cleaning(OFF/ON),Avalible:OFF,ON		false	string
  windMode	Absorption strength for L series(scrubber), Suction Power for S/SP series(vacuum). Avalible:LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH
Must match subSweepMode: LOW -> LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH, MEDIUM -> MEDIUM/HIGH, HIGH -> HIGH		false	string
  areaIds	clean areas, required when cleanEveryWhere is false		false	array
  fixedLaps	fixed laps, required when duration is null, [1,3]. Will be ignored if HOMING		false	integer
  backPointId	1. null or empty string is default behavior go back to station
2. a valid back point id specify a customize back point. created by  POST /openapi/v1/map/backPoint		false	string
  startTime	start time format, eg: '04:52 PM'(hours:minutes am/pm)		true	string
  repeat	repeated days, available values(note the DOT): 
"Mon."
"Tue."
"Wed."
"Thur.",
"Fri."
"Sat."
"Sun."		false	array

Status:

code	description	schema
200	OK	ResponseVoid

Response Params:

name	description	type	schema
data	dataset	object	
success	used to determine whether the call is successful	boolean	
code	response status code	integer(int32)	integer(int32)
info	response description	string	
rid	traceId is used to trace the records of API calls	string	

Response Example:

{
	"data": {},
	"success": true,
	"code": 0,
	"info": "",
	"rid": ""
}
Update schedule

url:/app/openapi/v1/schedule

method:PUT

produces:application/x-www-form-urlencoded,application/json

consumes:*/*

Note:

If cleanEveryWhere is false, areaIds is required. Scrubbers(L series) can only create SWEEP missions. Vacuums(S series) can create both PATROL and SWEEP missions.
If sweepMode is PATROL, subSweepMode can be one of: SPOT_CLEAN, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH.
If sweepMode is SWEEP, subSweepMode can be one of: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH. Scrubbers can also set subSweepMode to VERY_QUIET.

Example:

{
  "duration": 30,
  "mapId": 1100011697639116,
  "mapVersion": "map.1111699509667377.20230616-2.20240115-10",
  "cleanEveryWhere": false,
  "sweepMode": "PATROL",
  "subSweepMode": "HIGH",
  "edgeMode": "ON",
  "windMode": "LOW",
  "areaIds": [
    "0",
    "3"
  ],
  "fixedLaps": 1,
  "backPointId": "-1",
  "id": 56,
  "deviceOpenId": "1234",
  "startTime": "10:40 am",
  "repeat": [
    "Mon.",
    "Tue.",
    "Wed."
    "Thur.",
    "Fri.",
    "Sat.",
  	"Sun.",
  ]
}

Must match subSweepMode: LOW -> LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH, MEDIUM -> MEDIUM/HIGH, HIGH -> HIGH		false	string

Get all schedule by device

url:/app/openapi/v1/schedule/list/{deviceOpenId}

method:GET

produces:application/x-www-form-urlencoded

consumes:*/*

Note:

Params:

name	description	in	require	type	schema
deviceOpenId	device open id	path	true	string	
X-Api-Key	Key	header	true	string	
X-Api-timestamp	timestamp	header	true	string	
X-Api-signature	signature	header	true	string	

Status:

code	description	schema
200	OK	ResponseListScheduleTaskOpenResp

Response Params:

name	description	type	schema
data	dataset	array	ScheduleTaskOpenResp
  deviceId		integer(int64)	
  id	schedule id	integer(int64)	
  duration	duration (min)	integer(int64)	
  executionDays	execution days	array	string
  startTime	start time	string	
  endTime	end time	string	
  mapId	map id	integer(int64)	
  areas	list of areas	array	Area
    id	user defined area id, required when creating mission/schedule(the name of the parameter is 'areaIds')	string	
    name	area name	string	
    type	area type	string	
  sweepMode	clean mode,values:PATROL,HOMING,SWEEP	string	
  subSweepMode	sweep intensity,values:LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH,SPOT_CLEAN	string	
  edgeMode	edge cleaning(OFF/ON),Avalible:OFF,ON	string	
  windMode	L series: Absorption strength, S/SP series: Suction Power. Avalible:LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH	string	
  cleanEveryWhere	cleaning of the entire map is required	boolean	
  enable	scheduled task effective or not	boolean	
  backPointId	mission back point id	string	
  backPointName	mission back point name	string	
  backPoint	back point	Point	Point
    x	x	number(double)	
    y	y	number(double)	
    yaw	The robot's heading angle in radians. Range: [-π, π]	number(double)	
  fixedLaps	fixed laps	integer(int32)	
success	used to determine whether the call is successful	boolean	
code	response status code	integer(int32)	integer(int32)
info	response description	string	
rid	traceId is used to trace the records of API calls	string

Start play audio on device

url:/app/openapi/v1/audio/start

method:PUT

produces:application/x-www-form-urlencoded,application/json

consumes:*/*

Note:

Example:

{
  "deviceOpenId": "",
  "audioName": "001/002/testAudio",
  "selfDefined": false,
  "loop": false,
  "timeout": 0,
  "interval": 0
}

Params:

name	description	in	require	type	schema
X-Api-Key	Key	header	true	string	
X-Api-timestamp	timestamp	header	true	string

Mission
Create new temporary mission

url:/app/openapi/v1/mission

method:POST

produces:application/x-www-form-urlencoded,application/json

consumes:*/*

Note:

If cleanEveryWhere is false, at least one of userDefinedArea or areaIds is required. Scrubbers(L series) can only create SWEEP missions. Vacuums(S series) can create both PATROL and SWEEP missions.
If sweepMode is PATROL, subSweepMode can be one of: SPOT_CLEAN, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH.
If sweepMode is SWEEP, subSweepMode can be one of: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH. Scrubbers can also set subSweepMode to VERY_QUIET.

Example:

{
  "duration": 60,
  "mapId": 1100011697639116,
  "mapVersion": "map.1111699509667377.20230616-2.20240115-10",
  "cleanEveryWhere": false,
  "sweepMode": "PATROL",
  "subSweepMode": "HIGH",
  "edgeMode": "ON",
  "windMode": "LOW",
  "areaIds": [
    "0bfae0a2-2d74-400a-abcc-a43fb66895df",
    "c5ace709-97bf-47d0-a4fd-4ca3c6ff3802"
  ],
  "fixedLaps": 1,
  "backPointId": "a4d37e64-b390-408b-8ad6-894c4bbcccf9"
  "deviceOpenId": "2WEXXKE33F",
  "userDefinedArea": [
    {
      "x": 0,
      "y": 1
    },
    {
      "x": 0,
      "y": 2
    },
    {
      "x": 1,
      "y": 1
    }
  ]
}

Params:

name	description	in	require	type	schema
X-Api-Key	Key	header	true	string	
X-Api-timestamp	timestamp	header	true	string	
X-Api-signature	signature	header	true	string	
createTmpMissionOpenRequest	CreateTmpMissionOpenRequest	body	true		
  deviceOpenId	your device open id		true	string	
  duration	task time limit, unit(minutes), [1, 1440].		false	integer(int32)	
  fixedLaps	fixed laps, required when duration is null, [1,3].		false	integer(int32)	
  mapId	map id that task will use		true	integer(int64)	
  mapVersion	map id version that task will use		true	string	
  cleanEveryWhere	option to enable/disable cleaning of the entire place. If this is false at least one of userDefinedArea or areaIds is required.
default value: false		false	boolean	
  sweepMode	clean mode,values:PATROL,SWEEP		true	string	
  subSweepMode	sweep intensity,values:VERY_QUIET, LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH,SPOT_CLEAN
default value: LOW		false	string	
  edgeMode	edge cleaning(OFF/ON),Avalible:OFF,ON		false	string	
  windMode	Absorption strength for L series(scrubber), Suction Power for S/SP series(vacuum). Avalible:LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH
Must match subSweepMode: LOW -> LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH, MEDIUM -> MEDIUM/HIGH, HIGH -> HIGH		false	string	
  areaIds	clean areas, required when cleanEveryWhere is false		false	array	string
  backPointId	1. null or empty string is default behavior go back to station
2. a valid back point id specify a customize back point. created by  POST /openapi/v1/map/backPoint		false	string	
  userDefinedArea	Custom area, please ensure that the area is closed and within the map range		false	array	Point
    x	x		false	number(double)	
    y	y		false	number(double)	

Status:

code	description	schema
200	OK	ResponseString

Response Params:

name	description	type	schema
data	mission id	string	
success	used to determine whether the call is successful	boolean	
code	response status code	integer(int32)	integer(int32)
info	response description	string	
rid	traceId is used to trace the records of API calls	string	

Response Example:

{
	"data": "1700000000",
	"success": true,
	"code": 0,
	"info": "",
	"rid": ""
}

    endBattery	Ending battery level(relative)	integer

 -   APP_TEMP: Temporary task created via mobile application
 -   APP_TIMING: Scheduled task created via mobile application
 -   APP_FAV: Favorite task launched on a mobile application
 -   PAD_TEMP: Temporary task launched on the robot's tablet
 -   PAD_TIMING: Scheduled task created on the robot's tablet
 -   PAD_FAV: Favorite task launched on the robot's tablet
 -   SCAN_CODE: QR Code task
 -   OPEN_API:  Scheduled task created via open api or temporary task launched via open api	string	
    taskEndReasonEnum	Task end reason
 -   TIME_OUT: Time limit reached
 -   LAPS_REACHED: Completed set rounds
 -   APP_MANUAL: Manually stopped on APP
 -   PAD_MANUAL: Manually stopped on PAD
 -   PAD_TIMING: Scheduled task created on the robot's tablet
 -   SYSTEM_ABEND: Favorite task launched on the robot's tablet
 -   SYSTEM_PREEMPT: Preempted by new task
 -   JOINT_CLEAN_SRC_END:  Preceding sweep not finished.	string	
    abendSubReasonEnum	error enum, corresponding to field errDesc 
- EMERGE_STOP: Extended emergency stop 
- MANUAL_MODE: Extended manual mode 
- LONGTIME_MANUALCHARGE: Extended manual charging mode 
- WAIT_MANUAL_HANDLE: Extended waiting for manual assistance 
- WAIT_MANUAL_HANDLE_WATER: Extended waiting for water assistance 
- SYSTEM_STATUS_ERROR: Extended system errors 
- ABNORMAL_TIMEOUT: Maximum time for task exceeded 
- CHASSIS_TO_STATION_SIG: Cleaning mechanism malfunction 
- CHARGING_TIME_UNREASONABLE: Overextended charging time 
- LOW_CLEAN_EFFICIENCY: Low cleaning efficiency 
- SUB_SYSTEM_PREEMPT: Preempted by new task 
- NOT_RUNNING_TIMEOUT: Task ended due to system errors 
- ROBOT_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT: Prolonged shutdown 
- HIGH_AIR_PRESSURE: Air pressure too high 
- LOW_AIR_PRESSURE: Air pressure too low 
- PREEMPTED_NOT_EXECUTED: Skipped due to high-priority task running 
- LIDAR_OBSTRUCTED: Lidar is blocked 
- FRONT_DEPTH_OBSTRUCTED: The front depth camera is blocked 
- BACK_DEPTH_OBSTRUCTED: The rear depth camera is blocked 
- MAP_MISMATCH_NOT_EXECUTED: The map does not match and the task is not executed 
- WIRING_ENTANGLEMENT: The brush may be tangled with debris or cables 
- WHEEL_STUCK: The robot's wheels are stuck 
- DISC_BRUSH_FELL_OFF: The brush may fall off from the machine 
- ROLLED_CARPET: The robot may be stuck in the carpet and can't move forward 
- VACUUM_HOSE_DROP: The vacuum hose is not properly connected or fixed 
- SQUEEGEE_DROP: The squeegee is not properly connected or fixed 
- STATION_ADD_WATER_ERROR: Water refilling has timed out at the workstation 
- ROLL_BRUSH_MOTOR_OVERLOAD: Roller brush motor overload 
- LEFT_SIDE_MOTOR_OVERLOAD: Left side brush motor overload 
- RIGHT_SIDE_MOTOR_OVERLOAD: Right side brush motor overload 
- ABNORMAL_DISCHARGE_SEWAGE: Recovery tank drain timeout 
- CHARGING_FAILED: Recharging failed 
- CHARGING_FAILED_FAULT_CHARGER: Charging Failed: Faulty charger/contactors or a dirty auto-charging plate 
- CHARGING_FAILED_COMM_ERROR: Charging Failed: Unstable communication between robot and docking station 
- CHARGING_FAILED_NO_TOUCH: Charging Failed: Communication error between the robot and docking station 
- CHARGING_FAILED_NO_STATION: Charging Failed: Unable to detect docking station 
- DOOR_BLOCKING: Unable to pass through due to the door being closed or obstructed 
- ABNORMAL_TIMEOUT_PAUSED: Long periods of inactivity, preempted by scheduled tasks 
- LEAVE_DOCKING_FAILED: Failed to leave the docking station 
- DIRTY_BOX_SIG_ERROR: Recovery tank float sensor malfunction 
- RIGHT_MOTOR_OVERLOAD: Right wheel motor overload 
- LEFT_MOTOR_OVERLOAD: Left wheel motor overload 
- WORKER_STATION_EMERGE_STOP: The workstation has its emergency stop button pressed 
- BACK_DEPTH_CAMERA_ERROR: Rear Depth Camera Malfunction 
- FRONT_DEPTH_CAMERA_ERROR: Front Depth Camera Malfunction 
- DISC_BRUSH_DAMAGE: The disc brush motor is damaged 
- OBSTACLE_BLOCKING: Robot was blocked by an obstacle 
- LONGTIME_BEPREEMPTED: Task start delayed by prolonged high-priority task 
- LONGTIME_WAIT_WATER_FINISH: Prolonged water refill or drainage 
- JOINT_CLEAN_MAP_VERSION_NOT_EQUAL: TeamClean cannot start because the map between the two robots is inconsistent 
- JOINT_CLEAN_SRC_END: Preceding sweep not finished	string	
    cumulativeDistance	Distance traveled for the task, unit: meter	integer

Create back point

url:/app/openapi/v1/map/backPoint

method:POST

produces:application/x-www-form-urlencoded,application/json

consumes:*/*

Note:

Create back point, the robot must be online, and the input point should be within the map.

Example:

{
  "deviceOpenId": "GVXCC05JPA",
  "mapId": 1721645647269112,
  "name": "bp name",
  "x": 2,
  "y": 2,
  "yaw": 1.28
}

X-Api-signature	signature	header	true	string

  deviceOpenId	robot open id		true	string
  mapId	map id		true	integer(int64)
  name	back point name,length should less than 20		true	string
  x	x-coordinate		true	number(double)
  y	y-coordinate		true	number(double)
  yaw	The robot's heading angle in radians. Range: [-π, π]		true	number(double)

	"rid": ""

Must match subSweepMode: LOW -> LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH, MEDIUM -> MEDIUM/HIGH, HIGH -> HIGH		false	string
  areaIds	clean areas, required when cleanEveryWhere is false		false	array

CZ Robots Webhook Integration Guide

This guide explains how company administrators configure webhook subscriptions and how receiving systems verify and process webhook requests.

1. Overview

CZ Robots sends webhook events when one of the following robot states changes:

Event type	Description
robot.error.changed	The robot's active error-code set changed.
robot.pose.changed	The robot's reported position (x, y) or heading (yaw) changed.
robot.task.status_changed	A task started, ended, changed identity, or changed status.
robot.maintenance.changed	One or more V2 maintenance items changed.
robot.need_help_door_call	The robot requested assistance opening a door.

Subscriptions are scoped to the administrator's current company. Only company administrators can create, view, update, verify, rotate, or delete subscriptions.

The examples below use these placeholders:

OPERATION_BASE_URL: the Operation service URL, including the /opt context path.
ADMIN_TOKEN: an authenticated company administrator token.
SUBSCRIPTION_ID: the subscription ID returned by the API.
WEBHOOK_SECRET: the secret returned with the subscription.
2. Callback Endpoint Requirements

The callback URL must:

Use HTTPS.
Have a publicly resolvable host.
Not resolve to a loopback, private, link-local, multicast, carrier-grade NAT, or reserved address.
Not include URL user information such as https://user:password@example.com/hook.
Not include a URL fragment.
Accept HTTP POST requests with Content-Type: application/json.
Complete the connection within 3 seconds and return a response within 5 seconds.

Redirects are not followed. Configure the final HTTPS URL as the callback URL.

3. Authentication and API Response Format

All subscription-management requests require the company administrator token in the token header:

token: <ADMIN_TOKEN>
Content-Type: application/json

Successful Operation API responses use this envelope:

{
  "success": true,
  "code": 200,
  "data": {},
  "rid": "trace-id"
}

Timestamps in subscription responses, including verifiedAt, gmtCreate, and gmtModified, are Unix timestamps in milliseconds.

4. Create and Activate a Subscription
4.1 Create the subscription
POST <OPERATION_BASE_URL>/v1/webhook-subscriptions
token: <ADMIN_TOKEN>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "callbackUrl": "https://example.com/webhooks/czrobots",
  "eventTypes": [
    "robot.error.changed",
    "robot.pose.changed",
    "robot.task.status_changed",
    "robot.maintenance.changed",
    "robot.need_help_door_call"
  ]
}

The event list must contain at least one supported event type. Duplicate event types are removed automatically.

Example response data:

{
  "id": 42,
  "companyId": 2,
  "callbackUrl": "https://example.com/webhooks/czrobots",
  "eventTypes": [
    "robot.error.changed",
    "robot.maintenance.changed",
    "robot.task.status_changed"
  ],
  "status": "PENDING",
  "secret": "AabHnFvuKE54rMbS5Gafsw9fD0ja4mefAlRtv3THAM4",
  "gmtCreate": 1784640000000,
  "gmtModified": 1784640000000
}

The service generates the secret. It is a 32-byte random value encoded as unpadded Base64 URL text, normally 43 characters long. Store it as sensitive credentials.

A company cannot create two subscriptions with the exact same callback URL. Different callback URLs may be configured as separate subscriptions.

4.2 Implement endpoint verification

A newly created subscription remains PENDING and does not receive business events until verification succeeds.

During verification, CZ Robots sends an encrypted request like this:

POST /webhooks/czrobots
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json
X-Webhook-Id: evt_verify_7cd841d9a0494cddaf06a25f13cbd802
X-Webhook-Timestamp: 1784640000
{
  "iv": "base64url-encoded-12-byte-iv",
  "encrypt": "base64url-encoded-ciphertext-and-tag"
}

After AES-GCM decryption, the plaintext is:

{
  "messageType": "challenge",
  "data": {
    "challenge": "generated-challenge-value"
  }
}

Return the same challenge in a JSON response with any 2xx status:

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "challenge": "generated-challenge-value"
}

The value must match exactly. A missing, modified, or non-JSON challenge response fails verification.

4.3 Request verification

After the receiver is ready, call:

POST <OPERATION_BASE_URL>/v1/webhook-subscriptions/<SUBSCRIPTION_ID>/verify
token: <ADMIN_TOKEN>

Successful verification response data:

{
  "verified": true,
  "status": "ACTIVE"
}

Failed verification response data:

{
  "verified": false,
  "status": "VERIFICATION_FAILED",
  "failureReason": "callback did not return the expected challenge"
}

Verification may be requested again after correcting the receiving endpoint.

5. Decrypt Requests

Every verification and business-event request includes:

Header	Meaning
X-Webhook-Id	Request trace identifier. For business idempotency, use the authenticated data.id after decryption.
X-Webhook-Timestamp	Time at which the HTTP request was created, in Unix seconds.

The request body is encrypted as follows:

key = SHA-256(WEBHOOK_SECRET as UTF-8)
iv = 12 cryptographically random bytes
algorithm = AES-256-GCM with a 128-bit authentication tag
encrypt = AES-GCM(key, iv, plaintext JSON)

iv and encrypt use unpadded Base64 URL encoding. The 16-byte GCM authentication tag is appended to the ciphertext in encrypt. Decryption must fail closed if the key, IV, ciphertext, or authentication tag is invalid. Plaintext webhook bodies are not supported.

The following Node.js example uses only built-in cryptography:

import crypto from "node:crypto";
import express from "express";

const app = express();
const secret = process.env.CZ_ROBOTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET;

app.post(
  "/webhooks/czrobots",
  express.raw({ type: "application/json" }),
  (req, res) => {
    const traceId = req.get("X-Webhook-Id");
    const timestamp = req.get("X-Webhook-Timestamp");
    const rawBody = req.body.toString("utf8");

    if (!traceId || !timestamp || !secret) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: "missing webhook credentials" });
    }

    const requestTime = Number(timestamp);
    const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    if (!Number.isFinite(requestTime) || Math.abs(now - requestTime) > 300) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: "stale webhook request" });
    }

    let message;
    try {
      const envelope = JSON.parse(rawBody);
      const key = crypto.createHash("sha256").update(secret, "utf8").digest();
      const iv = Buffer.from(envelope.iv, "base64url");
      const encrypted = Buffer.from(envelope.encrypt, "base64url");
      const ciphertext = encrypted.subarray(0, encrypted.length - 16);
      const authTag = encrypted.subarray(encrypted.length - 16);
      const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv("aes-256-gcm", key, iv);
      decipher.setAuthTag(authTag);
      const plaintext = Buffer.concat([
        decipher.update(ciphertext),
        decipher.final(),
      ]).toString("utf8");
      message = JSON.parse(plaintext);
    } catch {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: "unable to decrypt webhook message" });
    }

    if (message.messageType === "challenge") {
      return res.status(200).json({ challenge: message.data.challenge });
    }

    const eventId = message.data.id;
    // Persist the event ID before processing so duplicate deliveries are safe.
    console.log("CZ Robots webhook", eventId, message.data);
    return res.status(200).json({ received: true });
  }
);
 public static JSONObject decrypt(String key, String encryptedBody) {
        try {
            JSONObject envelope = JSON.parseObject(encryptedBody);
            byte[] iv = Base64.getUrlDecoder().decode(envelope.getString("iv"));
            byte[] encrypted = Base64.getUrlDecoder().decode(envelope.getString("encrypt"));
            if (iv.length != IV_LENGTH) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid webhook IV");
            }
            Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding");
            cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, keySpec(key), new GCMParameterSpec(TAG_LENGTH_BITS, iv));
            byte[] plaintext = cipher.doFinal(encrypted);
            return JSON.parseObject(new String(plaintext, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unable to decrypt webhook message", e);
        }
    }

For replay protection, store processed event IDs and reject duplicate business events. AES-GCM authentication ensures modified ciphertext cannot be processed as a valid message.

6. Manage Subscriptions
List subscriptions
GET <OPERATION_BASE_URL>/v1/webhook-subscriptions
token: <ADMIN_TOKEN>

The data field is an array of subscription objects ordered by creation time, newest first.

The secret is returned only when a subscription is created or its secret is rotated. Store it immediately; list and update responses do not expose it. Never write the secret to client-side logs, analytics, or error reports.

Update a subscription
PUT <OPERATION_BASE_URL>/v1/webhook-subscriptions/<SUBSCRIPTION_ID>
token: <ADMIN_TOKEN>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "callbackUrl": "https://example.com/webhooks/czrobots",
  "eventTypes": [
    "robot.error.changed",
    "robot.task.status_changed"
  ],
  "enabled": true
}

callbackUrl and eventTypes are required on every update. enabled is optional.

Setting enabled to false changes the status to DISABLED.
Changing the callback URL changes an enabled subscription to PENDING; verify it again.
Explicitly setting enabled to true on a non-active subscription changes it to PENDING; verify it again.
Changing only event types on an active subscription keeps it active.
Rotate the secret
POST <OPERATION_BASE_URL>/v1/webhook-subscriptions/<SUBSCRIPTION_ID>/rotate-secret
token: <ADMIN_TOKEN>

Rotation immediately replaces the old secret and changes the subscription status to PENDING. Update the receiving system with the returned secret, then call the verification endpoint. Business events are not delivered while the subscription is pending.

Delete a subscription
DELETE <OPERATION_BASE_URL>/v1/webhook-subscriptions/<SUBSCRIPTION_ID>
token: <ADMIN_TOKEN>

Deletion is permanent.

Subscription statuses
Status	Meaning
PENDING	The endpoint must be verified before business events are delivered.
ACTIVE	Verification succeeded and subscribed events can be delivered.
VERIFICATION_FAILED	The most recent verification attempt failed.
DISABLED	Delivery is disabled by an administrator.
7. Business Event Envelope

After decryption, business messages contain the common event envelope in data:

{
  "messageType": "event",
  "data": {
    "id": "evt_bc401d00661a46aaab26c76295291287",
    "type": "robot.error.changed"
  }
}

The complete data event envelope uses this structure:

{
  "id": "evt_bc401d00661a46aaab26c76295291287",
  "type": "robot.error.changed",
  "apiVersion": "2026-07-01",
  "occurredAt": 1784640226709,
  "device": {
    "openId": "98HZRK5SQF",
    "licensePlate": "CZ-001"
  },
  "data": {}
}
Field	Description
id	Unique event ID.
type	Event type.
apiVersion	Payload contract version. The current version is 2026-07-01.
occurredAt	Event occurrence time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
device.openId	Public robot identifier.
device.licensePlate	Robot license plate. This field may be absent when no value is registered.
data	Event-specific payload.

Receivers should ignore unknown JSON fields to remain forward-compatible.

8. Error Change Event

Event type: robot.error.changed

{
  "id": "evt_bc401d00661a46aaab26c76295291287",
  "type": "robot.error.changed",
  "apiVersion": "2026-07-01",
  "occurredAt": 1784640226709,
  "device": {
    "openId": "98HZRK5SQF",
    "licensePlate": "CZ-001"
  },
  "data": {
    "codes": [
      {
        "code": 204801,
        "desc": "Emergency stop button is pressed"
      },
      {
        "code": 204898,
        "desc": "English error description"
      }
    ],
    "addedCodes": [204801, 204898],
    "removedCodes": [],
    "previousCodes": []
  }
}
Field	Description
codes	Complete current error state. Each item contains the numeric code and its English description.
codes[].desc	English description. It is an empty string when no description is registered.
addedCodes	Numeric codes added by this change.
removedCodes	Numeric codes removed by this change.
previousCodes	Complete numeric error-code state before this change.

Use codes as the authoritative current state. Use the other arrays when change-level processing is required.

9. Task Status Change Event

Event type: robot.task.status_changed

The same event type represents task start, task status changes, a transition to a different task, and task end.

{
    "occurredAt": 1785891434020,
    "apiVersion": "2026-07-01",
    "data": {
        "coverage": 0.95,
        "previousTaskId": "1775699698077_1785880800000",
        "previousIsRunning": true,
        "isRunning": true,
        "changeType": "STATUS_CHANGED",
        "progress": 0.98,
        "previousSweepType": "Sweep",
        "sweepType": "Sweep",
        "taskId": "1775699698077_1785880800000",
        "status": {
            "code": 8,
            "name": "ABSORBS_WATER"
        },
        "previousStatus": {
            "code": 1,
            "name": "ON_GOING"
        }
    },
    "id": "evt_58d7885ac3ad47479bab16802a3a5b25",
    "type": "robot.task.status_changed",
    "device": {
        "licensePlate": "L3-15048",
        "openId": "VLSBGG57HG"
    }
}
Field	Description
changeType	Currently always STATUS_CHANGED.
previousIsRunning	Whether a task was running before the change.
isRunning	Whether a task is running after the change.
previousTaskId	Previous task ID when the previous state was running.
taskId	Current task ID when the current state is running.
previousStatus	Previous task status object when available.
status	Current task status object when a task is running.
progress	Current task progress reported by the robot.
coverage	Current task coverage reported by the robot.
previousSweepType	Previous sweep-mode enum name when the previous state was running and the value was available.
sweepType	Current sweep-mode enum name.

Interpret the task lifecycle as follows:

Condition	Meaning
previousIsRunning=false, isRunning=true	A task started.
Both values are true and taskId changed	A different task started.
Both values are true and the status changed	The current task status changed.
Both values are true and sweepType changed	The current task sweep mode changed.
previousIsRunning=true, isRunning=false	The task ended.

Fields that are not meaningful for a non-running task may be absent.

Known task status values are:

Code	Name	English Description
-10	WAITING	Waiting
-2	DEEP_CLEAN_WAITING	Waiting
-1	UNKNOWN	Unknown
0	READY	Ready
1	ON_GOING	OnGoing
2	PAUSE	Pause
3	DONE	Done
4	STOP	Stop
5	ROUTING	Preparing
6	ABEND	Abend
7	CHARGING	Charging
8	ABSORBS_WATER	Absorbs Water
9	BACK_TO_STATION	Back to Station
10	MANUAL_HANDLING	Waiting Manual Handling
11	CHARGING_BROKEN	Charging Broken
12	TAKE_ELEVATOR	Riding Elevator
13	TAKE_ELEVATOR_DONE	Elevator Ride Completed
14	PASS_THROUGH	Heading to Elevator
15	WARNING	Warning
16	TAKE_ELEVATOR_PRE	Waiting for Elevator
17	IGNORE	Ignore
18	WIFI_MAP_AUTO_CHECKING	Confirming The Map
19	PULL_NEW_VERSION_MAP	Pulling new version map

Unknown status codes are represented with the name UNKNOWN.

Known task sweep values are (sweepType contains the enum name, not the numeric code):

Code	Name	English Description
-1	NoTask	No Task
0	Sweep	Full Cleaning
3	Patrol	Patrol Cleaning
4	Charge	Charge
5	Homing	Homing
6	DustPushing	Dust Mopping
9	ReplaceWater	Replace Water
10	PassThrough	Elevator ride
11	SpecLocation	Go to Point
12	GoPoint	Go to Point
13	ToSafeArea	To Safe Area
14	DeepClean	Deep Cleaning
15	Mapping	Mapping Mode
16	Tracking	Follow-Me Mode

Unknown or missing sweep codes are represented as NoTask for a running task.

10. Pose Change Event

Event type: robot.pose.changed

The first valid pose report establishes a baseline without emitting an event. Subsequent reports emit an event whenever the numeric value of x, y, or yaw changes, with no distance or angle threshold. Numeric formatting differences such as 38.82 and 38.820 do not count as changes. Reports with missing or null pose coordinates are ignored. Changes to other report fields do not trigger this event.

Example decrypted event data:

{
  "id": "evt_pose_example",
  "type": "robot.pose.changed",
  "apiVersion": "2026-07-01",
  "occurredAt": 1791948771875,
  "device": {
    "openId": "98HZRK5SQF",
    "licensePlate": "CZ-001"
  },
  "data": {
    "previousPose": { "x": 38.80, "y": 1.65, "yaw": -3.11 },
    "pose": { "x": 38.82, "y": 1.65, "yaw": -3.11 }
  }
}
Field	Description
previousPose	Previous valid reported pose, containing x, y, and yaw.
pose	Current reported pose, containing only x, y, and yaw.
11. Maintenance Change Event

Event type: robot.maintenance.changed

Only changed V2 maintenance items are included.

{
  "id": "evt_3e958cd895cf4bf4ba44f51e2da6fee8",
  "type": "robot.maintenance.changed",
  "apiVersion": "2026-07-01",
  "occurredAt": 1784625005254,
  "device": {
    "openId": "M2QE0VTH4W",
    "licensePlate": "CZ-002"
  },
  "data": {
    "previousLastUpdate": 1784624959,
    "lastUpdate": 1784624991,
    "changedItems": [
      {
        "changeType": "UPDATED",
        "code": 103,
        "type": "Side Brushes",
        "previous": {
          "left": 698,
          "max": 720
        },
        "current": {
          "left": 697,
          "max": 720
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
Field	Description
previousLastUpdate	Previous robot maintenance update marker.
lastUpdate	Current robot maintenance update marker.
changedItems	Only items whose underlying maintenance data changed.
changedItems[].changeType	ADDED, UPDATED, or REMOVED.
changedItems[].code	Maintenance item code.
changedItems[].type	English maintenance item name.
previous	Previous values, or absent when the item was added.
current	Current values, or absent when the item was removed.
left	Remaining maintenance life reported by the robot. Unit: hours
max	Maximum maintenance life reported by the robot. Unit: hours
12. Door Assistance Event

Event type: robot.need_help_door_call

This event is emitted when the robot reports that it needs help opening a door.

{
  "id": "evt_924c7c4ed7c54439b8d6a90d50397885",
  "type": "robot.need_help_door_call",
  "apiVersion": "2026-07-01",
  "occurredAt": 1784640400123,
  "device": {
    "openId": "98HZRK5SQF",
    "licensePlate": "CZ-001"
  },
  "data": {}
}

This is a discrete notification event rather than a replaceable robot state. Handle each unique event ID once.

13. Delivery Responses and Retries

Return a response as soon as the event has been durably accepted. Perform slow business processing asynchronously.

Receiver result	Delivery behavior
Any 2xx status	Delivery succeeds and is not retried.
408, 429, or 5xx	Delivery is retried when attempts remain.
Connection or timeout failure	Delivery is retried when attempts remain.
Other non-2xx status, including most 4xx responses	Delivery fails permanently without retry.
3xx status	Redirects are not followed and the delivery fails permanently.

The normal delivery flow allows at most two attempts: the initial attempt and one retry. After the first retryable failure, the retry is scheduled for 1 minute later. Actual delivery may occur later because of scheduling, queue load, or an earlier pending delivery for the same subscription. If the second attempt fails, the delivery is marked DEAD and no further failure retry is scheduled.

Worker recovery can cause additional requests when an attempt did not finish recording its result. The attempt limit is not a guarantee that a receiver will see at most two HTTP requests.

Deliveries can be repeated when a receiver accepts a request but the response is lost. Store and deduplicate by the decrypted event's data.id before applying business effects.

Task status events are state-collapsed: an older failed task-state delivery may be skipped when a newer task state exists. Receivers should still compare occurredAt with the latest applied state and avoid replacing newer state with older state.

14. Receiver Checklist

Delivery order is not guaranteed, including for events of the same type. Pending events can be sent while an earlier event is waiting for retry or being processed. Receivers should use occurredAt to avoid applying stale state and deduplicate discrete notifications by event ID.

Expose a public HTTPS endpoint without redirects.
Decrypt every request with AES-256-GCM and reject authentication failures.
Return the exact challenge from a decrypted challenge message.
Deduplicate business events by the decrypted event's data.id.
Use occurredAt to protect state from stale events.
Return 2xx only after durable acceptance.
Return 408, 429, or 5xx only when retrying the same request may succeed.
Return another 4xx status for permanent request rejection.
Ignore unknown JSON fields.
Store the webhook secret securely and update it immediately after rotation.
